description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for the attack hit data (hits.csv) of a specified scan task in AI Red Teaming. The URL is valid for 2 hours. An empty string is returned if the data has not been generated
description_zh: AI Red Teaming 获取扫描任务攻击成功数据（hits.csv）的临时下载链接，链接有效期 2 小时，数据未生成时返回空字符串
name: GetScannerTaskHitDataUrl

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. This is the TaskId returned by CreateTargetScanTask or the ScannerTaskId returned by ListScanTasksByTarget. This parameter is registered as optional but is required in practice. An empty value returns HTTP status code 400. If the task does not exist or belongs to another tenant, HTTP status code 400 is returned uniformly to avoid exposing whether the resource exists
parameters.help_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识（CreateTargetScanTask 返回的 TaskId，或 ListScanTasksByTarget 返回的 ScannerTaskId）；登记为选填但实际必填，空值返回 400；任务不存在或归属其他租户时统一返回 400，不暴露资源是否存在
parameters.name: scanner_task_id

Data.description_en: The query result, which contains the task identifier and the temporary download URL for the hit data
Data.description_zh: 查询结果，包含任务标识与命中数据临时下载链接

ScannerTaskHitDataDownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL for the attack hit data (hits.csv). The URL is valid for 2 hours. After the URL expires, call this operation again to obtain a new URL. If the task is an existing task or the agent execution mode does not produce hit data, this parameter is an empty string. The actual value is a signed temporary URL of Object Storage Service (OSS) that contains signature parameters
ScannerTaskHitDataDownloadUrl.description_zh: 攻击成功数据（hits.csv）的临时下载链接，有效期 2 小时，过期需重新调用本接口获取；存量任务或 agent 执行模式未产出命中数据时为空字符串。实际值为对象存储签名临时链接（含签名参数）

ScannerTaskId.description_en: The scan task identifier echoed from the request
ScannerTaskId.description_zh: 请求中扫描任务标识的回显

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
